title: Settings
description: Manage company information and the platform's appearance.

comingSoon.ai-prompts: The AI-assisted closing act uses a versioned prompt in Cloud Functions (CLAUDE.md §12.4) and Gemini is never called from the browser. Editing the prompt from here requires first defining a safe backend review flow for that change.
comingSoon.connections: There are no configurable external integrations yet — the platform only connects to Firebase and Gemini, both fixed per environment (.env), not per user.
comingSoon.webhooks: Outgoing webhooks are out of scope for the current MVP. Documented here as a future proposal, not as active functionality.

appearance.themeCardHelp: Choose the platform's theme. Your preference is saved on this device and applies without reloading the page.

appearance.sizeHelp: Changes apply across the sidebar once saved.
